This document covers the handover of Shopfront, the AWS-based e-commerce platform that processes all customer orders. Customers interact with the React storefront, which is served via CloudFront to an Application Load Balancer positioned in front of the EKS cluster. The services running on EKS rely on RDS PostgreSQL for order data and Redis for sessions and carts.

This document serves as the handover for Paygate, the Azure payment platform that authorises card payments for our online stores.

The React frontend goes through Azure Front Door to an Application Gateway, which routes traffic to our AKS cluster. The .NET services on AKS depend on Azure SQL, Azure Cache for Redis and Service Bus.
**Trigger:** Azure DevOps pipelines build the images and push them to ACR, and Flux syncs the releases to AKS.
